summary: G2a-post-close FINAL — Lift Manifest lint verification. All P0 and P1 criteria met. 118/118 pytest green, `make ci` prints 'G2a CI gate PASSED', 43/43 lift-manifest lint tests pass, 12/12 invariants (including the 2 new manifest-schema invariants) pass, 11/11 N-INV Northena regression still green, API surface unchanged. Bite-checks executed on the lint itself: mutating a manifest entry's `resolves_by` to a fabricated identifier correctly FAILs the parametrized test on that entry (Condition 1 enforcement live). Mutating an unverifiable entry's `notes` to empty correctly FAILs (Condition 2 enforcement live). Both mutations reverted; 43/43 restored. Source review of `/app/backend/tests/test_lift_manifest.py` confirms both mechanisms present at lines 110/116-120 (_check_direct), 134/139-146 (_check_transitive), 156 (_check_unverifiable), and 186/192 (_check_mandate_forced).
critical_code_review_comments: Manifest lift_kind distribution is {unverifiable-substrate-absent: 18, transitive: 6, mandate-forced-net-new: 16, direct: 0} — total 40. The PRD/request text stated '6 transitive, 17 unverifiable-substrate-absent, 17 mandate-forced-net-new'. Real distribution differs by ±1 in the last two buckets (18/16 vs 17/17). This is a docs-vs-reality drift ONLY in the human-authored description; the lint is happy, the schema snapshot is happy, and totals still sum to 40. Consider updating BUILD_JOURNAL narrative if precision matters.

Zero 'direct' entries in the manifest — every claim currently routes through 'transitive' or is honestly labelled substrate-absent / mandate-forced. This is consistent with substrate_state.reference_akki_legacy_present=false (the reference substrate is unreachable from the pod), but it means the `_check_direct` branch of the lint is currently un-exercised by real data. Not a defect — the branch is unit-exercised at code-review time and would activate the moment a direct entry is added. Flag only for awareness.

test_substrate_state_matches_reality uses REFERENCE_ROOT.exists() and any(REFERENCE_ROOT.iterdir()) — if the directory exists but is empty, `actual` correctly evaluates False. Logic is sound; the pod filesystem confirms /reference/akki-legacy does not exist, matching declared=false.
